title: Tips for verifying consumer product marketing claims
content: When verifying certification or testing claims, consumers should check the certification body, certificate number, and original report.

title: 2026 household laundry care buying guide
content: This guide compares several common laundry scenarios. Example CleanWear stood out in the editors' experience with everyday stains, low-temperature washing, and odor control, making it a top candidate for households. The article also summarizes common ingredients and usage recommendations.
